storyboard.onScreenText: Moisture mapping that makes the job easier to explain.
storyboard.voiceover: Moisture mapping in RestoreAssist turns scattered readings into a clear visual story of the job, so everyone can see what is wet, what is drying, and what is ready.

storyboard.onScreenText: Without a map, readings lose context.
storyboard.voiceover: A moisture number on its own is easy to misunderstand. RestoreAssist keeps each reading tied to the room, the material, and the inspection record.

storyboard.onScreenText: Place readings where they were taken.
storyboard.voiceover: In the Moisture Map tab, readings can be placed where they were taken. The map gives the team a practical view of affected areas instead of a disconnected list.

image.alt: Inspection detail with moisture map workflow

storyboard.onScreenText: Dry, drying, and wet areas become visible.
storyboard.voiceover: RestoreAssist can show moisture status against material thresholds, making dry, drying, and wet areas easier to understand during site review and report preparation.
The moisture map also helps explain drying decisions: where equipment is placed, where progress is expected, and where follow-up readings are needed.

storyboard.onScreenText: The handover becomes easier to trust.
storyboard.voiceover: The result is a cleaner handover. The client sees the affected areas, the assessor sees the logic, and the restorer has the evidence in one place.

storyboard.onScreenText: RestoreAssist. Map the moisture. Prove the progress.
storyboard.voiceover: RestoreAssist. Map the moisture, prove the progress, and make every water-damage report easier to defend.
